title: Agniveer Army Recruitment 2026: Eligibility, Rally & Salary
metaDescription: Indian Army Agniveer recruitment 2026-27: GD, Technical, Clerk, Tradesman eligibility, age 17.5-22, physical standards, CEE exam, salary details.
headline: Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment 2026: Complete Rally Guide

sections.content:
The Indian Army conducts Agniveer recruitment through regional rallies organized by Army Recruiting Offices across states. The 2026-27 cycle covers Agniveer General Duty, Agniveer Technical, Agniveer Clerk and Store Keeper Technical, Agniveer Tradesman, Women Military Police, Soldier Technical Nursing Assistant, Sepoy Pharma and Junior Commissioned Officer Religious Teacher.

Each category has distinct educational and physical benchmarks. Candidates must be residents of the district or state where the rally is conducted, and applications are submitted online through the official Join Indian Army portal before the rally admit cards are issued.
sections.title: Agniveer Categories and Who Can Apply

sections.content:
Agniveer General Duty requires Class 10th pass with 45 percent aggregate and 33 percent in each subject, while Technical needs 12th with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English at 50 percent aggregate. Clerk and Store Keeper Technical requires 12th in any stream with 60 percent aggregate and 50 percent in each subject, with English and Maths mandatory.

The physical standards demand a 1.6 km run within 5 minutes 30 seconds for Group I full marks, at least 10 pull-ups on the beam, plus qualifying 9-feet ditch and zig-zag balance tests. Minimum height is 170 cm for GD, Technical and Tradesman and 162 cm for Clerk, with chest expansion of 5 cm.
sections.title: Eligibility and Physical Standards

sections.content:
Selection begins with Phase I, the online Common Entrance Exam (CEE), a computer-based test held across the country. The GD paper carries 100 marks over 50 questions in one hour, while Technical and Clerk papers carry 200 marks each, with negative marking applied per wrong answer.

Candidates who clear the CEE proceed to Phase II, the recruitment rally, which includes document verification, physical measurement, the physical fitness test, and medical examination. Final merit lists are prepared from combined performance, and selected candidates report for military training at designated regimental centres.
sections.title: CEE Exam and Selection Process

sections.content:
Agniveers serve for four years on a monthly package that rises each year: Rs. 30,000 in year one, Rs. 33,000 in year two, Rs. 36,500 in year three and Rs. 40,000 in year four. Thirty percent of the monthly package is contributed to the Agniveer Corpus Fund, which the government matches, and is paid out as a lump sum Seva Nidhi on completion of service.

On completing four years, up to 25 percent of each batch may be selected for regular cadre enrolment based on performance and organizational need. Exiting Agniveers receive the Seva Nidhi package along with skill certificates and priority in paramilitary and state police recruitment.
sections.title: Pay, Allowances and Life After Service

faqs.a: Agniveer General Duty, Technical, Clerk and Tradesman applicants must be between 17.5 and 22 years old. Soldier Technical allows up to 23 years, Sepoy Pharma requires 19 to 25 years, and Junior Commissioned Officer Religious Teacher accepts candidates from 25 to 34 years of age.
faqs.q: What is the age limit for Agniveer Army recruitment 2026?

faqs.a: Agniveer General Duty needs Class 10th pass with 45 percent aggregate and 33 percent in each subject. Technical requires 12th with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English at 50 percent. Clerk or Store Keeper needs 12th in any stream with 60 percent aggregate and 50 percent in each subject.
faqs.q: What education is required for Agniveer GD, Technical and Clerk?

faqs.a: The Physical Fitness Test includes a 1.6 km run to be completed within 5 minutes 30 seconds for full marks, a minimum of 10 pull-ups on the beam, a 9-feet ditch jump and a zig-zag balance test. Running and pull-ups carry marks while the ditch and balance tests are qualifying in nature.

faqs.a: Agniveers receive a monthly package starting at Rs. 30,000 in the first year and rising to Rs. 40,000 in the fourth year. Seventy percent is paid in hand each month while thirty percent goes into the Agniveer Corpus Fund. Service lasts four years, after which up to 25 percent may be retained for regular service.
